sloka: ततस्ते त्रिदशाः सर्वे परिवार्य शचीसुतम् ।रावणस्य सुतं युद्धे समासाद्य प्रजघ्निरे ।। ७.२८.८ ॥
transliteration: tataste tridaśāḥ sarve parivārya śacīsutam ।rāvaṇasya sutaṁ yuddhe samāsādya prajaghnire ।। 7.28.8 ॥

translations.english: Then all the gods, surrounding Shachi's son Jayanta, approached Ravana's son in battle and attacked him.
